Drive with a purpose, a mission and the knowledge that
you’ve got power to spare. The 3.5-liter i-VTEC® V-6 generates
250 hp and 253 lb-ft of torque – enough to tow up to 4,500 lbs.6
Standard equipment like an integrated Class III trailer hitch,
heavy-duty radiator and fluid coolers means the Pilot comes
fitted with most of what you need for some serious hauling.
Pilot 4WD EX-L shown in Polished Metal Metallic with accessory towing kit, hitch ball and trailer harness.
